title: Not All Forgetting Is Equal: Retention Dynamics in Fine-Tuned Image Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2604.11508v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fine-tuning a pretrained classifier leaves some samples reliably learned and others cycling between correct and incorrect. Curriculum learning, data pruning and dataset cartography assume that pattern is a property of the sample, untested. We record per-sample correctness at every epoch while fine-tuning ResNet-18 and DeiT-Small on an imbalanced retinal OCT dataset and CUB-200-2011, matching samples by image identity and holding the split fixed across seeds. Per-sample retention is reproducible: cross-run Spearman correlation of the fitted decay constant is 0.37 to 0.59 over ten seeds. It is architecture-specific: two runs of one backbone agree more than two backbones on identical data (0.45 and 0.59 within against 0.30 between on OCTDL). Loss after five frozen-backbone epochs predicts a different run's decay constant at 0.29 to 0.43. The Ebbinghaus exponential does not survive: monotone decay, the one shape it can represent, is 0.1%

translated_title: 并非所有遗忘都相同：微调图像分类器中的记忆保持动态
translated_abstract: 微调预训练分类器时，一些样本被可靠地学到，而另一些样本则在正确与错误之间反复循环。课程学习、数据剪枝和数据集地图学都假设这种模式是样本本身的属性，但这一假设从未被验证。我们在不平衡的视网膜OCT数据集和CUB-200-2011上微调ResNet-18和DeiT-Small时，逐epoch记录每个样本的正确性，通过图像标识匹配样本，并在不同随机种子间保持数据划分固定。结果表明：每个样本的记忆保持是可复现的，在十个种子上拟合衰减常数的跨运行Spearman相关系数为0.37至0.59；它是架构特定的，同一骨干网络的两次运行比相同数据上两个不同骨干网络更一致（OCTDL上内部为0.45和0.59，之间为0.30）；五个冻结骨干epoch后的损失可以预测另一次运行的衰减常数，相关系数为0.29至0.43；而艾宾浩斯指数衰减模型不能成立，单调衰减——它能表示的唯一形状——仅占0.1%。
tldr: 该研究首次通过逐epoch记录每个样本的正确性验证了微调中的遗忘模式，发现样本记忆保持是可复现且依赖架构的，而经典的艾宾浩斯指数衰减模型无法描述实际的遗忘动态。
en_tdlr: By recording per-sample correctness at every epoch during fine-tuning, this study shows that per-sample retention is reproducible and architecture-specific, and that the classic Ebbinghaus exponential decay model fails to capture actual forgetting dynamics.
